build_rules: Do not modify Platform B v1.
Do not reopen Thread D v1.
Do not build full commercial integrations now.
No real LIS, MES, ERP, eQMS, VRS, EPCIS, or GMP production data.
Every extension must preserve hashing, rehashing, evidence integrity, chain-of-custody truth, and governed AI boundaries.
doctrine: COBIT-Chain does not replace source systems.
COBIT-Chain does not approve GMP work.
COBIT-Chain does not replace Quality Unit review.
COBIT-Chain does not become MES, LIMS, ERP, eQMS, VRS, EPCIS, or ServiceNow.
COBIT-Chain verifies whether the evidence chain, workflow state, identity, authority, AI output, and dependency state can be trusted.
Official records remain in source systems.
